database_storage.fact: Runtime dictionary fetch returns ReadOnlySpan<byte> slices over mapped/native bytes; no managed string materialization is required for the hot route.
LocRegistry exposes UTF-8 span lookup and decodes into caller-owned Span<char> through TryWriteVisualSpanFromUtf8.
LocalizationManager has zero-GC span/buffer APIs and legacy string APIs; legacy FormatLocalized is cold compatibility and must not become the VWS/subtitle route.

task_02_localization_database_analysis.string_policy: Hot consumers must request UTF-8 spans or write directly into caller-owned char buffers. Legacy string accessors remain compatibility-only unless a future AST/profiler proof marks them hot.
gaps_found: ZeroGCFormatter and LocNumericArg numeric TryFormat calls do not explicitly pass CultureInfo.InvariantCulture in the current source snapshot.
LocRegistry brace/caret placeholder overflow returns false from helper methods, allowing the caller to fall back to literal token copying instead of immediately forcing a truncation path.

route: VocalWarningSystem.TryQueueWarning(byte warningId, float severity01, float cooldownSeconds, byte flags, uint sourceId)

source_evidence.fact: VWS queues warning IDs and publishes typed vocal/subtitle signals; no subtitle string is constructed in the observed dispatch route.
SubtitleCueSignal is the hot typed lane. Sync runtime drains SignalBus snapshots into fixed DTO buffers and records decode telemetry.
SubtitleManager decodes token hashes into leased char buffers, queues bounded buffers, then applies TMP SetCharArray in the pending swap flush.

task_03_vws_and_subtitle_pipeline_mappin.phase_note: Presentation frame prep currently occurs through BabelSubtitleSyncRuntime, while the final TMP mutation is guarded in SubtitleManager.FlushPendingSubtitleSwap. Any source edit must preserve owner-phase publication and avoid hot GlobalRegistry polling.

observed_design: Fixed slot count and bit-mask allocation prevent runtime collection growth.
BabelLease exposes a Span<char> over native vault-backed storage when available and a preallocated tmp bridge for TMP SetCharArray.
TmpTextNoAlloc already routes ReadOnlySpan<char> into CharBufferPool/SetCharArray instead of assigning TMP_Text.text.
SubtitleManager owns additional preallocated pending/queue buffers for subtitle swap safety.

source_evidence.fact: Babel leases are fixed-capacity and release-tracked.
TMP writes use SetCharArray from leased buffers or empty static buffer.

planned_edits: Do not replace the existing pool with a new allocator.
Harden formatter/decode cursor behavior centrally so all downstream UI/VWS text routes inherit fail-closed semantics.
Keep buffer overflow handling truncating and non-throwing; preserve fixed capacities and no resizing in gameplay.
rejected_architecture: Per-subtitle StringBuilder cache: still managed and expands under pressure.
Allocating new char[] per caption: deterministic GC spikes.
Direct TMP_Text.text writes: managed string route violates domain mandate.
New jobs for single subtitle formatting: tiny job and same-frame readback would be slower and less predictable.

scalability_ladder.low: Fixed 512-char Babel lease, truncate with ellipsis, skip optional styling.
scalability_ladder.middle: Same buffer path, full localized warning text, bounded queue.
scalability_ladder.high: Same truth route, richer VisualSync styling sourced from telemetry.
scalability_ladder.ultra: Same DTO/layout authority, optional visual overkill only after SetCharArray-safe text is produced.

task_05_telemetry_and_reporting_planning.black_box_policy: If Task 14 adds a subtitle/localization telemetry ring, it must use a fixed-size 300-frame buffer and dump to Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_1423.bin on NaN/crash-equivalent text corruption or explicit dump trigger.
task_05_telemetry_and_reporting_planning.truthfulness_policy: No zero-GC runtime claim may be recorded as measured unless profiler/GCMonitor or an explicit allocation test produced proof. Static audits are labelled static.

next_loop_candidates: Harden LocRegistry placeholder overflow to force truncation instead of literal fallback.
